Loading slicer paths…

Near-side lid mount close-up. Select Isometric to restore the whole base.

Drag to orbit · scroll to zoom. These are extrusion centerlines, not solid beads. Travel and startup/purge paths are omitted. Layers retain their actual heights.

Bambu Studio 2.9.1.70 · P2S 0.4 mm · Generic PETG · 0.20 mm layers · four walls · 25% gyroid · automatic tree supports, including supports on the part. All three slices use identical settings; support reduction comes from the geometry.

Solid motor foot

The unused opening below the NEMA17 face is filled down to the floor, removing its unsupported underside.

Pitched side windows

45° roofs replace broad horizontal window tops. The narrower openings close gradually as layers rise.

No trapped bearing supports

45° undersides replace the flat bearing and adjustment shelves, including the rounded axle roots. All four bays now contain zero support paths in this slice. Use four M5×40 socket-head adjustment bolts with the existing washers and inserts.

Motor-side lid mounts

The current base replaces the hanging mounts with gussets rooted into the motor wall. With the same slicer settings, neither mount region contains support or support-interface paths. The bearing changes also retain these support-free motor-side mounts.

Bearing supports eliminated

Compared with the preceding base, total supports fall from 4.24 g to 0.62 g. Select Before bearing slopes and Bearing / bolt bays to inspect the change. The remaining supports are around the accessible motor aperture. A second slice of the 100 mm T8 / 2× / 6805 Z base also has zero support paths in those bays (slice check). Only the base needs reprinting; replace its four adjustment bolts with M5×40 ISO 4762 socket heads (8.5 mm head diameter).

Full printability comparison

Loading comparison…

Support totals are calculated from the G-code’s support and interface extrusion. Area totals group paths by position; they do not certify removability. The four bearing-adjustment bays contain no support or interface extrusion through all sliced layers. This is a slice of the 40 mm, 1× printed-screw base, not every size. Print fit and material strength still need a physical trial.
